name: Scrap Atoll
design_intent:
SCRAP ATOLL — THE SCRAPWORKS tier-2 RADIAL ring (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 §Scrapworks row 12; the scrap sibling of atoll). A crater-rim of scrap platforms wraps AROUND a central void WELL: two bottom shelves flanking the well, two mid shelves out at the sides (+520 climbs), two top perches flanking the well mouth, and a central spring THRONE hovering over the maw. Combat WRAPS around the rim; every platform overlooks the same well. No hazards (radial geometry is the hook). Kill identity = knock rivals INWARD into the well OR OUTWARD off the rim. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%); AT1 radial check: deaths split BOTH into the well AND off the outer rim.

GEOMETRY (centred on x=0 for radial symmetry): BL bottom-left shelf (trampoline, x-1400..-320, top y1120, h128) / BR (trampoline, x320..1400, top y1120) flank the CENTRAL WELL (gap x-320..320 = 640px, open to the void). ML mid-left (bubblegum, x-1900..-1300, top y600) / MR (x1300..1900, top y600) sit OUT at the sides, 520px above the base. TL top-left perch (spring, x-1000..-320, top y200) / TR (spring, x320..1000, top y200) flank the well mouth up top. CENTRAL THRONE (spring, x-180..180, top y-360) hovers 560px above the top perches over the well. ONE full-width lethal void band (rim y1260); the carved BL<->BR gap is the well maw. Bounds -2500..2500 (mid-shelf outer edges ~600px inside the side blast = the OUTER RIM), top -3010, bottom 1920 (672px recovery sky under the base; deep well under the throne). VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Overcast grey open_sky = a scrap crater.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning: trampoline 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; ~395px trampoline drift / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 640-800px in <1s). Traversal WRAPS around the ring; every move is flight-required (horizontal > 527 OR vertical climb > 480):
- BOTTOM crossing BL<->BR over the WELL (x-320..x320 = 640px of open void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall INTO the well. Verb: FLY.
- LEFT climb BL->ML: 520px vertical (1120->600). Trampoline apex 270 reaches only y850 (270px short). JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- UPPER-LEFT ML->TL: ~300px horizontal AND ~400px up (diagonal ~500px). Bubblegum apex 180 falls short both ways. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- TOP crossing TL<->TR over the WELL (640px over the well mouth): > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY. (Right side BR->MR->TR mirrors the left.)
- CLIMB to the CENTRAL THRONE (top-360): 560px above the top perches (y200); a spring bounce off TL reaches y-280 (80px short) over the OPEN well. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: a fall INTO the well drops from the surface bottom down the central column to the bottom blast line (1920) = 672px (base) up to 2232px (throne) of sky -> a fuelled player boosts back up out of the well mouth (recovery gamble); a knock OUTWARD off ML/MR (~600px inside the side blast) is a shorter OUTER-RIM ring-out. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce route exists around the ring or up to the throne (every hop > 527 horizontal or > 480 vertical), so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

SIGNATURE: the scrap crater rim — the circuit's radial slot, a wrap-around fight over a lethal central maw.
